separateValidation: Shift-left versus ordinary-left/right routing is covered by CPU viewport tests plus inspection of NSEvent modifier wiring; CUA has no modifier-hold drag operation.

Q/E signs and equal flight distance are covered by CPU navigation tests plus keycode wiring review. CUA emits taps too short to reliably span a rendered frame, so sustained native Q/E movement is not claimed.
